item.tib: dbugs khyim sgang dang ldog gnyis ri phag sogs kyi myur rtsis gsar byed sgron ma tshig chung don bzang
item.coloph: de ltar lho byang nyi ma'i bgrod mtshams dang / dbugs khyim sgang gsum riShi'i phag zhag bcas/ re mig gsar spel tshig nyung don bzang 'di/ rang 'dra blo dman 'ga' la phan phyir du/ rgyal ba gnyis pa mnyam med sman ri ba'i/ gdan sar 'bod pa nyi ma'i ming can des/ sum glang gyim shod dpal gyi steng chen du/ sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa'i rgyan gyur shog bkra shis par gyur cig/
